description: 06:00 - 07:30: Balanced cement plug m 2765 m mixed and pumped 9,2 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 550 l/min. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 2900 l of drill water. Zeroed volume counters. Displaced the cement with 44 m3 strokes) of SW, 3700 l/min/ 147 bar. Pulled out of cement to 2765m at 4 min/stand. Theoretical TOC 2765 m MD.
